headlines.title: 주택가격전망 CSI, 4년 10개월 만 최고치
headlines.summary: [서울=뉴시스] 최동준 기자 = 집값 오름세가 지속되면서 주택가격전망지수(CSI)가 4년 10개월 만에 최고 수준으로 상승했다. 28일 한국은행이 발표한 '7월 소비자동향조사'에 따르면 소비자심리지수(CCSI)는 전월(106.6)보다 0.2포인트 오른 106.8이다. 주택가격전망CSI는 전월(120)보다 7포인트 상승한 127이다.

key_headlines.title: Capital Gains Tax on Multi-Property Sales Likely to Cap at 1 Billion Won
key_headlines.summary: The government is finalizing real estate tax reform with a proposed 10 billion won ceiling on capital gains tax deductions for multi-property owners. Experts debate whether the limitation is excessive, while concerns mount about policy impact on single-homeowner taxpayers.

key_headlines.title: Stock Market Crashes on 'Black Tuesday' with KOSPI Down 10.8% and KOSDAQ Down 7.7%
key_headlines.summary: South Korean stock indices plummeted on July 28 due to combined pressures from US and Chinese economic concerns and weakness in semiconductor stocks following Chinese chip manufacturer Changxin Memory's IPO success. The KOSPI recorded its second-largest daily decline in history.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse Crisis Spreads from Apartments to Villas and Multi-Unit Buildings
key_headlines.summary: The rental deposit shortage crisis has expanded beyond apartments to non-apartment housing including villas, with only 36% renewal rate on villa deposits and rising prices. The government is actively pursuing short-term supply measures including corporate rental housing expansion.

key_headlines.title: Reverse Trading Surges 596% in Six Months as Elderly Investors Face Forced Liquidation
key_headlines.summary: Reverse trading (forced liquidation) surged from 56.5 billion won in January to 393.5 billion won in June, with investors aged 70 and above experiencing 791% increase in forced liquidation transactions. This reflects growing debt-financed investment risks among older demographics.

key_headlines.title: Government Adopts 'Korean IRA' Tax Incentive Program for AI Robots and Batteries
key_headlines.summary: The government designated six strategic industries including semiconductors, solar, batteries, AI robots, wind power, and critical materials for domestic production tax incentives. Companies producing more of these items will receive proportional tax cuts starting next year.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's real estate market faces critical policy reforms as the government introduces comprehensive tax restructuring focused on residential housing. Capital gains tax changes include a potential 10 billion won ceiling on multi-property deductions with a maximum 80% residential period deduction rate. The concurrent jeonse (deposit-based rental) crisis has spread from apartments to villas and multi-unit buildings, with only 36% renewal rates driving price increases. The government is pursuing aggressive supply measures including corporate rental housing expansion and accelerated third-phase new town projects with development timelines cut in half. Multi-property owner tax relief is being considered on a temporary basis to facilitate market exits.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government made historic first contact between budget officials and labor union leadership in approximately 20 years, with discussions centered on surplus tax distribution. The benchmark median income for four-person households will increase 6.7% to 6.92 million won next year, the highest on record, reflecting updated calculation methods incorporating latest consumer price indices and real GDP growth rates. Basic livelihood security benefits for four-person households will reach 2.217 million won, also a historic high. Currency market dynamics shifted as companies increased dollar-denominated borrowing by 19.4% in one month due to expectations of further won appreciation. Discussions continue regarding semiconductor tax revenue redistribution and fiscal stabilization measures for regions hosting major semiconductor manufacturing bases.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean stock markets experienced historic volatility on July 28, with KOSPI plummeting 10.8% and KOSDAQ declining 7.7%, marking the second-largest KOSPI daily decline ever. Multiple circuit breakers were triggered as program sell orders were suspended on both markets due to futures index movements exceeding threshold levels. Semiconductor stocks particularly suffered following concerns about Chinese semiconductor competition from Changxin Memory's successful IPO. Leverage-related ETFs face criticism for creating extreme volatility, with political figures describing KOSPI as a 'gambling game' and KOSDAQ as an 'ice rink' lacking liquidity. Forced liquidations accelerated as margin calls mounted amid market downturn.
sections.Industry & Technology: The government finalized the 'Korean IRA' framework covering six strategic industries: semiconductors, solar, secondary batteries, AI robots, wind power, and critical materials and components. Production-based tax incentives replace investment or R&D subsidies, with production volume directly determining tax reductions. Battery makers facing the electric vehicle demand gap found salvation in energy storage systems (ESS), with 'post-processing bottlenecks' expected to resolve by fourth quarter 2026. Auto parts maker Unique is diversifying into robot components while maintaining leadership in solenoid valves with 1-2% global market share. Loss-making battery companies unable to access tax credits may instead receive proportional subsidies based on production volume.
sections.Real Estate: High-leverage property purchases have driven up housing prices while simultaneously creating financing constraints as interest rate increases threaten the supply foundation itself. Corporate rental housing rapidly emerged as a solution to youth rental demand and non-apartment shortages, with government emphasizing supply source diversification. Redevelopment project experts stress urgent need for relocation loan regulation relief and expanded non-apartment housing supply in reconstruction areas. Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province initiated redevelopment of 1980s public apartments across five neighborhoods, designating them as planned development zones and launching preparatory committees. Property experts unanimously cite loan regulation relaxation as the most critical measure needed to prevent imminent relocation crises.
sections.International Economy: US Trade Representative Jamie Gerrish stated that Section 301 tariffs would not influence Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, maintaining separate policy pathways. President Trump intensified pressure on the Federal Reserve one day before the FOMC meeting, claiming that interest rate cuts could enable 12% US GDP growth and asserting that America should maintain the world's lowest rates. The FOMC meeting convened July 28-29 with market expectations of rate hold decisions despite presidential pressure. European Union has applied provisional trade agreements with Mercosur since May, while Japan initiated EPA economic partnership negotiations in June, gaining tariff advantages South Korea currently lacks. South Korean government is advancing long-delayed Korea-Latin America FTA negotiations with research suggesting potential 2% GDP growth impact.
sections.AI & Economy: Big Tech firms compete aggressively in AI infrastructure investment, with some issuing corporate bonds at yields exceeding 7% in junk bond territory, indicating market strain from capital demands. Meta's 12 billion dollar Texas data center bonds traded at speculative-grade yields reflecting concerns about capital intensity of AI deployment. Nvidia faces renewed 'circular transaction' controversy as it simultaneously acts as supplier and investor to GPU chip purchasers, supporting customer investments, equity stakes, and data center arrangements in what markets view as potentially unsustainable ecosystem dynamics. AI applications show effectiveness in capital market analysis and data anomaly detection, yet limitations remain in contract summarization and other specialized tasks where marginal utility over existing methods proves unclear. Korean cable manufacturer Gaon Electric obtained first US order for power distribution cables supplying big tech data centers, with 2026 US export projections reaching 300 billion won, triple 2025 levels.
sections.Others: Personal Information Protection Commission chairman acknowledged that victim compensation through financial penalties remains practically difficult, with discussions underway for integrated victim relief funds. The government is reinvigorating Korea-Latin America FTA negotiations previously stalled, with EU and Japanese precedents demonstrating substantial tariff reduction benefits. C-commerce (Chinese e-commerce) platforms captured nearly 80% of online import market share, with consumer complaints increasing sevenfold in two years as Chinese merchants dominate cross-border retail. University closures accelerated as school-age population fell below 500,000 students in 2026, with government applying financial support cutoffs to financially struggling institutions unable to meet enrollment targets, creating structural higher education sector contraction.
